notes: v412 — untangling ASX and NYSE for good. (1) Any holdings, pending orders or trades that ended up in the WRONG exchange’s account (from app versions before the accounts split) are automatically moved home the next time you open the Portfolio, and both cash balances are rebuilt to match their own trades. (2) Pending orders now show proper ✎ price and ✕ cancel BUTTONS you can tap on a phone — and they work from any view; the old ‘load NYSE to manage’ message is gone. (3) The Portfolio now opens on the exchange you’re actually trading (its own separate account); tap All for the combined view. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5); on phones close the tab fully and reopen.
